messages: nina (Design): Pushed a tiny mock for the private setup network step. Changes: single-line probe rows, one-click copy for debug commands, and an inline 'How this affects your private deployment' trigger that opens a slide-in aside. Screenshot attached. Thoughts? carlos (PM): Looks lightweight. Two asks: 1) make the copy button visible on hover & focus, 2) use explicit impact language (e.g., 'Blocks agent install'). mei (Eng): Copy button yes. I'll implement a 1-click clipboard helper and a small toast on success. For ARIA: suggest aria-live="polite" for the toast and aria-label="Copy SSH debug command" on the button. jay (DevEx): UX nit: prefer the aside to be non-modal so user keeps context. When it opens, focus should move to the aside heading and Esc closes it. Also include a short FAQ in the aside rather than full vendor docs. a11y-bot: Automated flag: current orange label fails contrast (3.0:1). Recommend darker hue to meet 4.5:1. Also ensure status has text + shape + color for non-visual cues. nina (Design): I'll darken the orange and swap labels to Reachable / Partial / Blocked + shape icons. Will annotate focus order and copy button states (idle/success/error). carlos (PM): Microcopy: change 'Learn more' to 'How this affects your private deployment'. In-aside heading: 'If a check fails' with short remediation steps and a 'Copy command' action. mei (Eng): Implementation note: each probe will include role="status" and aria-describedby linking to the remediation paragraph. Example: SSH port: Reachable. Will add tests for NVDA + VoiceOver. jay (DevEx): QA checklist I'm drafting: - status shows text + shape + color - amber/darker color meets 4.5:1 - copy buttons keyboard accessible with aria-labels - toast announces copy success via aria-live - aside focus lands on heading and Esc closes it - mobile stacks probes above descriptions nina (Design): Great checklist. I'll update mocks and push to the PR with annotations. Tagging everyone for dev review once it's up. :sparkles:
